Author: Ajay Bhanot

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:65191 Court No. - 64 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 2990 of 2024 Applicant :- Sunil Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 03 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rajiv Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA for the State contends that the police authorities in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 46998 of 2020 (Junaid Vs State of U.P. and another) reported at 2021 (6) ADJ 511 and with a view to implement the provisions of POCSO Act, 2012 read with POCSO Rules, 2020, have served the bail application upon the victim/legal guardian as well as upon the CWC.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
188 of 2018 at Police Station-Dadon, District-Aligarh under Sections 376, 323, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 46998 of 2020 (Junaid Vs State of U.P. and another) reported at 2021 (6) ADJ 511

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 06.11.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 08.01.2024.

sentences.text:
The following arguments made by Shri Rajiv Kumar Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The victim was wrongly shown as a minor of 16 years in the F.I.R. only to falsely implicate the applicant under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.
2.The age of the victim set out in the prosecution case is refuted in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P. and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) and on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.

entities.text: Monish Vs. State of U.P. and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) The victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that she is 16 years of age.
(iv) The medical report sent by the Chief Medical Officer determining the age of the victim opines that she is about 22-23 years of age.
3. The F.I.R. is a result of a petty neighbourhood dispute between the parties.
4. The applicant has been implicated under the stringent provisions of POCSO Act only to leverage the criminal case in the civil dispute between the parties.
5. Delay in taking out proceedings under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and consequent lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
6. The proceedings were instituted after much deliberation and at the instigation of interested parties.
7. After thorough and unbiased investigations, no implicatory evidence was gathered by the investigating officer against the applicant.
The applicant was not chargesheeted by the investigating officer and a final report was submitted in his favour.
8. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
9. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.

There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.

sentences.text: In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Sunil be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).

sentences.text: The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Photostat copy of the medical report drawn up by the Chief Medical Officer to determine the age of the victim shall be duly attested and retained by the Registry as part of the records of the Court.
The original medical report (if any) shall be returned to the concerned Chief Judicial Magistrate for onward transmission to the concerned Investigating Officer.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Sunil be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Photostat copy of the medical report drawn up by the Chief Medical Officer to determine the age of the victim shall be duly attested and retained by the Registry as part of the records of the Court.
The original medical report (if any) shall be returned to the concerned Chief Judicial Magistrate for onward transmission to the concerned Investigating Officer.
